parameters.query:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'offer_id', offer_id, 'title', title, 'company', company,
           'region', region, 'first_seen', first_seen) ORDER BY first_seen), '[]'::jsonb) AS existing
  FROM jobs.offers
 WHERE first_seen > now() - interval '60 days' AND duplicate_of IS NULL;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT x.*, d.duplicate_of
      FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
               offer_id text, source text, url text, title text, company text, location_raw text,
               region text, published_at date, description text, structured jsonb, raw jsonb,
               content_hash text)
      LEFT JOIN jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS d(offer_id text, duplicate_of text) USING (offer_id)
), previous AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.content_hash FROM jobs.offers o JOIN input i USING (offer_id)
), upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO jobs.offers AS o (offer_id, source, url, title, company, location_raw, region, published_at,
                                  description, structured, raw, content_hash, first_run_id, duplicate_of)
    SELECT offer_id, source, url, title, company, location_raw, region, published_at,
           description, structured, raw, content_hash, $3::uuid, duplicate_of
      FROM input
    ON CONFLICT (offer_id) DO UPDATE SET
        url = EXCLUDED.url, title = EXCLUDED.title, company = EXCLUDED.company,
        location_raw = EXCLUDED.location_raw, region = EXCLUDED.region,
        published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, description = EXCLUDED.description,
        structured = EXCLUDED.structured, raw = EXCLUDED.raw, content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
        last_seen = now(), duplicate_of = coalesce(o.duplicate_of, EXCLUDED.duplicate_of)
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upsert)::int AS upserted,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM input WHERE offer_id NOT IN (SELECT offer_id FROM previous))::int AS new,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM input i JOIN previous p USING (offer_id)
         WHERE p.content_hash <> i.content_hash)::int AS updated;

WITH s AS (
    INSERT INTO jobs.run_sources (run_id, source, fetched, new, updated, errors, error_sample)
    VALUES ($1::uuid, 'getonbrd', $2::int, $3::int, $4::int, $5::int, nullif($6, ''))
    RETURNING fetched, errors
)
UPDATE jobs.runs
   SET finished_at = now(),
       status = CASE WHEN (SELECT errors FROM s) = 0 THEN 'succeeded'
                     WHEN (SELECT fetched FROM s) > 0 THEN 'partial'
                     ELSE 'failed' END
 WHERE run_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING run_id, status, extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at)::int AS seconds;
